headline: CATL posts surprise profit slowdown as mainland shares plunge
summary: Contemporary Amperex Technology Limited (CATL) recorded a surprise slowdown in third-quarter net profits, causing its mainland shares to tumble by over 10%.
why: CATL is the world's largest electric vehicle battery manufacturer, and its financial results reflect supply chain health and consumer demand trends in the global EV market.

impacts.name: Electric Vehicles
impacts.why: Weakening profit growth for a top battery supplier signals potential slowdowns across the broader EV supply chain.

why_moved: A surprise earnings slowdown combined with warnings of lower future demand triggered an aggressive sell-off by institutional and retail investors.
